timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background.

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

tools.name: ListAgents
tools.description: Lists agents you can SendMessage to — in-process subagents you spawned, the teammates on your team, other local Claude sessions on this machine, your Claude sessions running in the cloud (when this session has cloud access; a cloud session receives your message but cannot message any session back yet — do not ask it to reply, read its answer in its own transcript), and (when Remote Control is connected here) your account's other sessions — Remote Control sessions on other machines and cloud sessions, each row labeled by kind. Names are the address: send with `SendMessage({to: "<name>", message: "..."})`, copying the name exactly as a row prints it. Append a row's ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — two rows share it, or an error asks you to disambiguate.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

Only use this when you genuinely need all of it or the user asked for the whole file; otherwise read it in parts with offset and limit, or search it.

tools.name: ReportFindings
tools.description: Report code-review findings as a typed list so the host UI can render them. Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

level.description: Effort level the review ran at

findings.description: Verified findings, most-severe first; empty if none survived

file.description: Repo-relative path of the file the finding is in

short_summary.description: Compressed label for compact UI (≤60 chars): the claim alone, no rationale or consequence clause

category.description: Short kebab-case slug of the finding type, e.g. "correctness", "simplification", "efficiency", "test-coverage"

verdict.description: Set when a verify pass ran; absent on inline-only reviews

outcome.description: Set ONLY when re-reporting after applying fixes: what happened to this finding

tools.name: SendFeedback
tools.description:
Use this tool to draft feedback about Claude Code when you hit a high-signal moment. That includes both PRODUCT issues and MODEL-BEHAVIOR issues:
- a reproducible tool or product failure was just resolved or abandoned
- the user clearly expressed frustration with Claude Code or with how you handled the task
- you hit a missing capability that blocked a reasonable request
- you notice, or the user points out, that your own behavior in this session went wrong, for example: you gave a confident answer then had to retract it; you stopped short and handed work back when you could have finished; you declined or disputed a reasonable request; you spawned more subagents than the task warranted; your tone was off; you asked more clarifying questions than needed; you expanded scope beyond what was asked

The draft is QUEUED LOCALLY. It is never sent without the user's explicit approval, and calling this tool renders no UI and does not interrupt the conversation, so never announce it or ask the user about it mid-task.

Write `details` as short labeled bullets in this exact order, one to three lines each, no narrative paragraphs:
- **What happened:** the observed behavior vs. what was expected, with exact error text if short. Facts only.
- **What the user said:** the user's own words that prompted this, quoted. If nothing did, write "User didn't comment; observed by the model." Never paraphrase sentiment into a stronger claim.
- **Repro:** the minimal steps or shape that reproduces it.
- **Evidence:** identifiers a reader can chase, such as request IDs, timestamps, file paths, versions. Omit the bullet if there are none.

Constraints:
- Never fabricate or exaggerate user sentiment; report only what actually happened.
- Everything in the draft must be sourced from the user or the session, never inferred: leave unknown fields blank rather than guess, and add a final **Cause:** bullet only for a root cause you verified in-session.
- Use `area` to name the part of Claude Code the feedback is about (a feature, command, or workflow, e.g. "hooks config", "/help", "file editing") when there is a clear one; leave it blank otherwise.
- Use `failure_mode` ONLY when the report is about model behavior (how Claude responded), not a product bug. Pick the single closest value, or `other` when it is a model-behavior issue that fits no listed value; omit the field only when the report is a product/tool bug with no model-behavior component.
- Use `task_category` to name what kind of task the session was doing, or `other` when it is a clear task that fits no listed value. Omit only if genuinely unclear.
- Do not include secrets or credentials. Refer to people by role ("a teammate", "the PR reviewer"), never by name, email address, or chat/user ID. This applies inside quoted user words too: replace a name or handle with a bracketed role (e.g. "[a teammate]") and keep the rest verbatim. Do not include customer-facing channel or DM IDs, or excerpts of customer content. Session, request, and run IDs, timestamps, repo/PR numbers, and file paths (written relative to the working directory, or ~-prefixed, not absolute paths under the user's home) remain the right evidence.
- If the issue looks like a security vulnerability: describe the class of problem, never a working exploit or step-by-step extraction path.
- Draft only at the natural moments listed above, and at most one draft per distinct issue; never re-draft the same issue in a session.

# --product-shot=<c1..c5|flow|edge:<name>|live:<scenario>>: the Product tab. The first four
# are fed by the debug fixture source (scripts/debug/product_fixtures.gd, edge names live there)
# through the shell's debug relays, the same path an MCP session takes; flow starts from c1 and
# saves one frame after each of start, advance and plan_next; edge:goal_menu opens the quarter goal's
# menu with a click on its strip. live draws
# ProductModel.live() over a run seeded through SprintSystem (_seed_product_live); live:pick_named is
# the type picker with B2C, a type and a name picked, live:pick_relang saves it and switches this run to
# English (<stem>_rebuilt: the rebuilt picker keeps the picks); live:decision_paper presses the asking card's
# "?", so the frame is Olaylar on the sprint paper; live:gate saves the MVP gate, presses its
# Yayınla and saves the v1.0 note (<stem>_publish); live:b2c_goal saves the planning with the lead's plan offered, applies
# it with no quarter goal (<stem>_lead), then takes the lead's cards back out, picks the goal Trust and applies the lead's
# plan again (<stem>_trust); live:plan saves the plan and presses Sprinti başlat (<stem>_start); live:rnd saves the planning with the
# founder in R&D, presses Ar-Ge'ye git and saves R&D with the founder's node selected (<stem>_go). live:overview_pre is
# the Sprint-1 plan with the pointer on the locked GENEL BAKIŞ tab (<stem>_tip); live:server_* is GENEL BAKIŞ on the
# live ERP (see _seed_server), the plain frame and, for the states that have a tip to read, <stem>_tip with the pointer
# on the control it belongs to. live:a4_<frame> are the Ürün > Sprint frame worlds (_seed_product_a4), each printing
# its PRODUCTSHOT line.
func _run_product_shot(id: String) -> void:
	_begin_shot()
	_seed_run_reproducible()
	var stem: String = "product_shot_" + id.replace(":", "_")
	if id.begins_with("live:"):
		_seed_product_live(id.trim_prefix("live:"))
		await _mount_shot_shell()
		EventBus.tab_changed.emit("product")
		if id == "live:overview_pre" or id.begins_with("live:server"):
			await _product_overview_shot(id.trim_prefix("live:"), stem)
			return
		if id in ["live:pick_named", "live:pick_relang"]:
			var picker: TypePicker = _shell.find_children("*", "TypePicker", true, false)[0]
			picker._pick_type("note_tool")
			picker._name = "Notly"   # LOC-DATA debug seed / name
			picker._save_draft()
		if id.begins_with("live:decision_paper"):
			await get_tree().process_frame
			for row: BoardRow in _shell.find_children("*", "BoardRow", true, false):
				if row.card.ask != null:
					row.action.emit("decide", {"card_id": row.card.id, "item": row.card.ask.item})
					break
			if id != "live:decision_paper":   # a real paper: its answer is open, so its options and their chips are in the frame
				await get_tree().create_timer(0.4).timeout
				_press_button_labelled(_shell, tr("MAIL_RESPOND"))
		if id.begins_with("live:a4_") and not await _product_a4_ready(id.trim_prefix("live:")):
			return
		var tip: String = String(_A4_WORLDS.get(id.trim_prefix("live:"), {}).get("tip", ""))
		if tip != "":
			await _product_tip_shot(tip, id.trim_prefix("live:"), stem)
			return
		# A frame before each action, the last one after them (stem + the action's suffix). English for this
		# run only: Localization.set_language would also store it as the player's language.
		var press := func(key: String) -> Callable: return _press_button_labelled.bind(_shell, tr(key))
		var to_en := func() -> void:
			TranslationServer.set_locale("en")
			EventBus.language_changed.emit("en")
		var kept: Array = []   # live:b2c_goal: the sprint's cards before the lead's plan
		var lead := func() -> void:
			kept.assign(GameState.product.sprint.cards)
			SprintSystem.apply_lead()
		var toward_trust := func() -> void:
			for card_id in GameState.product.sprint.cards.duplicate():
				if card_id not in kept:
					SprintSystem.remove(card_id)
			SprintSystem.pick_goal("trust")
			SprintSystem.apply_lead()
		# live:a4_run_w2: a second frame two game hours on (_02): the now line moves with the clock.
		var two_hours_on := func() -> void:
			TimeManager.advance_hours(2)
			print(_productshot_line("a4_run_w2"))
		var then: Dictionary = {"live:gate": [[press.call("PROD_SHIP_PUBLISH"), "_publish"]],
			"live:a4_run_w2": [[two_hours_on, "_02"]],
			"live:plan": [[press.call("PRODUCT_START_SPRINT"), "_start"]],
			"live:rnd": [[press.call("PRODUCT_GO_RND"), "_go"]],
			"live:pick_relang": [[to_en, "_rebuilt"]],
			"live:b2c_goal": [[lead, "_lead"], [toward_trust, "_trust"]]}
		var base := stem
		for step: Array in then.get(id, []):
			await get_tree().process_frame
			await get_tree().create_timer(0.4).timeout
			_save_shot(stem)
			step[0].call()
			stem = base + step[1]
		if id == "live:b2c_live":
			# Geçmiş açık: v1.0'ın satırı ilk haftanın kullanıcılarını okur.
			get_tree().get_first_node_in_group(&"window_layer").get_current_page_body()._set_ui(true, "history_open")
		if id == "live:b2b_quarter":
			get_tree().get_first_node_in_group(&"window_layer").get_current_page_body()._set_ui("quarter", "view")
		await _finish_shot(stem)
		return
	await _mount_shot_shell()
	_shell.debug_product_apply("c1" if id == "flow" else id.trim_prefix("edge:"))
	if id == "edge:goal_menu":
		await get_tree().process_frame
		var click := InputEventMouseButton.new()
		click.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
		click.pressed = true
		(_shell.find_children("*", "QuarterView", true, false)[0] as QuarterView).get_child(0).gui_input.emit(click)
	if id != "flow":
		await _finish_shot(stem)
		return
	for kind in ["start", "advance", "plan_next"]:
		_shell.debug_product_act(kind)
		await get_tree().process_frame
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.4).timeout
		_save_shot("%s_%s" % [stem, kind])
	get_tree().quit()


## GENEL BAKIŞ of a live:overview_pre or live:server_* shot, and the tip of the control the state is about: the pointer rests

func _product_overview_shot(scenario: String, stem: String) -> void:
	var page: Control = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group(&"window_layer").get_current_page_body()
	if scenario != "overview_pre":
		page._set_ui("overview", "view")
	if scenario == "server_tier":
		page._set_ui("enterprise", "server_preview")
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.5).timeout
	var aim: Dictionary = {"overview_pre": Fmt.upper(tr("PRODUCT_OV_TAB_OVERVIEW")),
		"server_80": tr("PRODUCT_SERVER_BTN_INCREASE").split("{n}")[0], "server_94": tr("PRODUCT_SERVER_BTN_DECREASE").split("{n}")[0],
			await get_tree().create_timer(0.6).timeout
			await frame.call("held_1")
			_on_pitch_requested("")
			await frame.call("held_meet")
		"released":
			SprintSystem.plan_next()
			SprintSystem.apply_lead()
			SprintSystem.start()
			layer.get_current_page_body().set_source(null)

			var before: int = TimeManager.current_speed
			TimeManager.focus_pause_armed = true
			get_tree().root.propagate_notification(NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_FOCUS_OUT)

func _build(id: String) -> Dictionary:
	var m: Dictionary
	match BASES.get(id, id):
		"c2": m = _c2()
		"c3": m = _c3()
		"c5": m = _c5()
		_: m = _c1()
	match id:
		"c4", "goal_menu", "approved":
			m.ui.view = "quarter"
			m.quarter = _quarter()
			if id == "approved":
				_apply(m, "approve", {"sprint": 8})
		"replan":
			_place(m, "filtreli", "next")
			m.next = _notly_next(true)
			m.header.live_version = "1.5"
		"cap_zero":
			m.center.capacity.total = 0
			m.center.staffed = false
			_clear_sprint(m)
		"team_none":
			# Kadro var ama Yapım ya da Test işinde kimse yok: kartlar planda, sprint başlamaz.
			m.center.capacity.total = 0
			_resum(m.center)
		"over_100":
			_place(m, "mobil_giris", "center")
		"over_125":
			_place(m, "mobil_giris", "center")
			_place(m, "ilk_tur", "center")
		"empty_start":
			_clear_sprint(m)
		"no_release":
			# MVP öncesi kapanış, hiç kart bitmedi: sürüm yok, çıkan yok, hız sıfır, basın satırı yok; v1.0'a
			# iki kart kaldı.
			m.versions = []
			m.header.live_version = ""
			m.center.mvp = _mvp_line()
			m.center.release.version = ""
			m.center.release.shipped = []
			m.center.release.velocity.done = 0
			m.center.release.press = {}
			m.center.release.result = null
		"gate":
			# MVP kapısı: Çekirdek'in üç kartı bitti, ürün oyuncunun Yayınla'sını bekliyor; sürüm ve basın yok.
			m.versions = []
			m.header.live_version = ""
			m.center.mvp = _mvp_line().merged({"done": 3}, true)
			m.center.release.version = ""
			m.center.release.gate = true
			m.center.release.press = {}
			m.center.release.result = null
		"release_fix":
			# Düzeltme satırları kapanıştaki gerçek sayıyı yazar: planlanırken 5 olan hat kapanışta 9'du; öbürü, hatalı
			# kapanan bir kartın hatası aynı hatta düştüğü için 1'e indi.
			var note: Dictionary = m.center.release
			note.shipped = [_deck("kisa_kayit", SprintCard.State.BITTI), _shipped_fix("kesinti", 9, 0),
				_shipped_fix("esitleme", 6, 1)]
			note.result = {"kind": "actual", "text": tr(Fmt.count_key("PRODUCT_RESULT_BUGS_ACTUAL", 15)).format({"n": 15})}
		"release_reviews":
			# Sürümden bir tik sonra B2C güncellemesinin yorumları: adlı yeni özellik, kapanan düzeltme ve güncellemeyi
			# suçlayan olumsuz yorum.
			m.center.release.reviews = SprintBridges.review_lines({"reviews": {"feature": "line_note_tool_capture_k2",
				"at": -1, "ids": ["PRODUCT_REVIEW_NEW_NAMED_2", "PRODUCT_REVIEW_FIX_2", "PRODUCT_REVIEW_NEG_INTEGRATIONS_1"]}})
		"history_empty":
			m.versions = []
			m.ui.history_open = true
			m.header.live_version = ""
		"history":
			m.ui.history_open = true
			m.ui.open_area = ""
		"mvp":
			m.versions = []
			m.header.live_version = ""
			m.center.mvp = _mvp_line()
		"quarter_no_pm":
			m.quarter.state = "locked_no_pm"
	return m

   242		var open_views: Array = VIEW_KEYS.keys().filter(func(id: String) -> bool:
   243			return (id != "overview" or m.get("overview") != null) and (id != "quarter" or m.quarter.state == "open"))
   244		if "overview" not in open_views:
   245			var overview := UiFactory.D_locked_tab(tr(VIEW_KEYS.overview))
   246			overview.tooltip_text = tr("PRODUCT_OV_LOCKED")
   247			_ctl_row.add_child(overview)
   248		_ctl_row.add_child(UiFactory.D_seg_tabs(open_views.map(func(id: String) -> String: return tr(VIEW_KEYS[id])),
   249			open_views.find(view), func(i: int) -> void: _set_ui(open_views[i], "view")))
   250		if "quarter" not in open_views:
   251			var quarter := UiFactory.D_locked_tab(tr(VIEW_KEYS.quarter))
   252			quarter.tooltip_text = tr("PRODUCT_QUARTER_NEED_PM")
   253			_ctl_row.add_child(quarter)
   254		_ctl_row.add_child(RnDUiShared.spacer())
   255		var founder: Dictionary = m.founder
   256		var founder_tip: String = tr("PRODUCT_FOUNDER_ON_TIP" if founder.on else "PRODUCT_FOUNDER_OFF_TIP")
   257		if founder.locked == "running":
   258			founder_tip = tr("PRODUCT_FOUNDER_LOCKED_TIP")
   259		elif founder.locked == "rnd":
   260			founder_tip = founder.rnd_text
   261		SprintUiShared.switch(_ctl_row, tr("PRODUCT_FOUNDER_IN_SPRINT"), founder.on,
   262			func(on: bool) -> void: _on_action("founder", {"on": on}), founder_tip, founder.locked != "")
   263		SprintUiShared.switch(_ctl_row, tr("PRODUCT_HISTORY"), _ui.history_open, _set_ui.bind("history_open"))
   264	
   265	
   266	## Yalnız yerel durum: geçmiş anahtarı, görünüm, açık modül, talep listesinin açıklığı ve açık kademe önizlemesi.
   267	func _set_ui(value: Variant, key: String) -> void:
   268		_ui[key] = value
   269		if key == "view":
   270			_last_view = value
   271		_queue_rebuild()
   272	
   273	
   274	## SPRINT görünümünde bu modül açık ve görünür: Destek kartı en çok açık hatası olan hattın modülüne, bir talep satırı kendi
   275	## modülüne götürür.
   276	func open_area(area_id: String) -> void:
   277		_set_ui("sprint", "view")
   278		_reveal_open = true
   279		_set_ui(area_id, "open_area")
   280	
   281	
   282	## İmleç bir adayın "+"ında: sayfa kurulmaz, kartın kimliği `ui.hover_card` olur, hayaletin hesabı kurulur (sayfanın bir sonraki
   283	## kurulumuna kadar saklanır) ve kapasitede çizilir; ayrılınca boşalır.
   284	func _on_candidate_hover(card_id: String) -> void:
   285		_ui.hover_card = card_id
   286		_sprint.set_ghost(card_id)
   287	
   288	
   289	func _on_action(kind: String, args: Dictionary) -> void:
   290		_ui.hover_card = ""   # kare için zorlanan hover ilk eylemde bırakılır
   291		if kind == "server_preview":
   292			_set_ui(args.id, "server_preview")
   293			return
   294		if kind == "edit":
   295			_set_ui("sprint", "view")
   296		if _source != null:
   297			_source.act(kind, args)
   298		else:
   299			_act(kind, args)
   300		_queue_rebuild()
   301	
   302	
   303	## Kaynak yokken eylem sprint motoruna gider; fikstürün eylem tablosuyla aynı türler. Karar kartta
   304	## cevaplanmaz: Olaylar kâğıdı seçili açılır.
   305	func _act(kind: String, args: Dictionary) -> void:
   306		match kind:
   307			"add", "pull": SprintSystem.add(args.card_id)
   308			"send_next": SprintSystem.send_next(args.card_id)
   309			"remove": SprintSystem.remove(args.card_id)
   310			"founder": SprintSystem.set_founder_in_sprint(args.on)
   311			"start": SprintSystem.begin_planned()   # kartsız planda boş sprint
   312			"delegate": SprintSystem.set_delegate(args.on)
   313			"plan_next": SprintSystem.plan_next()
   314			"publish": SprintSystem.publish()
   315			"apply_lead": SprintSystem.apply_lead()
   316			"decide": INBOX.show(args.item)
   317			"approve": SprintSystem.approve(args.sprint)
   318			"approve_all": SprintSystem.approve_all()
   319			"edit": SprintSystem.edit(args.sprint)
   320			"pick_goal": SprintSystem.pick_goal(args.area_id)
   321			"server_tier":
   322				InfraSystem.set_provider(args.id)
   323				_ui.server_preview = ""
   324			"server_step": InfraSystem.adjust_capacity(args.direction)
   325			"server_auto": ProductState.set_infra_auto(args.on)
   326			"team": EventBus.tab_changed.emit("hr")
   327			"rnd":
   328				# Önce sayfa: düğüm isteği monte olmuş Ar-Ge sayfasına düşer.
   329				EventBus.tab_changed.emit("rnd")
   330				EventBus.rnd_node_requested.emit(args.node, false)
   331			"hire":
   332				EventBus.tab_changed.emit("hr")
   333				get_tree().get_first_node_in_group(&"window_layer").get_current_page_body().open_atlas()
   334	
   335	
   336	## Değişiklik bir düğmenin ya da satırın kendi girdisinden geliyor: ağaç girdi bittikten sonra,
   337	## aynı karede gelen eylem ve durum değişikliği için bir kez kurulur.
   338	func _queue_rebuild() -> void:
   339		if not _rebuild_queued:
   340			_rebuild_queued = true
   341			_rebuild.call_deferred()
   342	
   343	
   344	## Sürüm notu açıkken saat tutulur. Her kurulumda yeniden tutmak sessizdir; bırakmak saati başlatmaz.
   345	func _hold_clock(on: bool) -> void:
   346		if on:
   347			TimeManager.hold_clock(HOLD_RELEASE_NOTE)
   348		else:
   349			TimeManager.release_clock(HOLD_RELEASE_NOTE)

class_name ProductModel
extends RefCounted

# Ürün sekmesinin sprint ekranının görünüm sözleşmesi. Sekme yalnız bu Dictionary'yi çizer.
# Üreten (canlı adaptör ya da debug fikstürü) içerik alanlarını çözülmüş metin olarak verir;
# eşik ve izinler bool gelir. Bileşenler kendi dilbilgisini PRODUCT_* anahtarlarından kurar.
#
# PRD terimi → sözleşme adı:
#   Alan → area {id, name, goal_text} (çeyrek hedefinin menüsü) · Modül → module (sol sütun)
#   Kart → card {id, name, kind, effort, state, remaining} (ÇEYREK ve sürüm notu); bu sprintin kartı pano satırıdır
#   (`center.cards`, aşağıda), sonraki sprintin kartı sağ sütunun kartıdır (`next.cards`, aşağıda)
#   Sprint → center {sprint, capacity, cards} · Sürüm → center.release {version, shipped, carried, velocity, press}
#   tür yeni/cila/düzeltme/araştırma → kind feature|polish|fix|research
#   kart durumları → SprintCard.State
#
# model = {
#   header: {name, live_version: "1.4" or "" (MVP öncesi), market: "B2C"|"B2B" or "" (tür yok), type_text,
#            users, paying (canlı B2C'de kitle ve ödeyen; -1 = yok)},

#                     reviews: [{source, text}] (B2C güncellemesinin öne çıkan yorumları, gelene dek boş),
#                     lead: person + {text, self}} or null}
# server = {tiers: [{id, name, tip (üstüne gelince; kilitliyse gerekçe), off (kilitli), preview (geçiş önizlemesi),
#                    final (Kurumsal'ın geri dönüşsüzlük notu ya da "")}], active (kademenin sırası),

#           (InfraSystem.capacity_state), load: "Yük %80 · boş pay ..." ("" kapasitesizde),
#           note: {text, tone: "over"|"warn"|"quiet", glyph} or null (tek satır: kesinti uyarısı, son otomatik büyüme ya da büyüme),
#           clause: "Kurumsal sunucu bekleyen 2 hesap" ya da "" (maddesi açık B2B hesap yoksa),
#           decrease/increase: {text, tip}, auto: {on, tip}}
# person = {name, role_text, look ({} ise baş harfler)}
# column = {sprint, kind: "current"|"proposed"|"empty", capacity: {used, total, done, state: "ok"|"over"|"blocked",
#           segments: [{pts}]} or null (puanlar kesirli), pm, flags: [...], cards: [card], approved}
# card = {id, name, kind, effort, state: SprintCard.State, remaining: -1 or float (kesirli; kapısı sonradan kapanan kart KILITLI)}
#
# Yeni ekranın okuma yüzeyi, yukarıdakilerin yanında (efor sayıları görünen eforudur: kalan ihtiyaç ÷ hazırlık kazancı):
#   founder: {on (kurucu sprint kartı alır), locked: "" | "running" | "rnd", rnd_text},
#   requests: null (B2C) | [{customer, card_id, card_name, module_id, mono (modülün iki harfi), value (yıllık), due_text (sözün, yoksa talebin son sprinti:

#             büyük aşama payları, eforu kesirli), planned (bu sprintin planında), stamp (başka sprintte: sprint numarası, yoksa
#             -1), addable (null: "+"nın değeri henüz istenmedi, `resolve_addable` ister; false: adaylıktan çıkmış kartın "+"ı yok),
#             bugs, fix_text}]}] (kilitli aday ve adaylarının hepsi kilitli modül yok),
#   prep: {pms: [{person, stars, cards (bu sprintin kartlarından hazırladıklarının adı), preparing (sonraki sütunda hazırladığı var)}]},
#   quarter: + {q, year (ürün çeyreğinin başladığı takvim çeyreği), pos, total (çeyreğin kaçıncı sprinti, kaç sprintlik)},
#   center: + {now_at (koşan sprintin haftasında şimdiki an, sprint başından hafta), close_at (SprintTimeline), progress: {done,
#             total, known (panonun sırasıyla kartların bilinen yükü)} (koşarken; saat ilerleyince `progress_at`), delegate: {on
#             (planlama PM'e devredilmiş), pm: person or null (çeyreği planlayan PM; yoksa devret kilitli)}, crew (bir aşamada `CLUSTER_OVER`dan çok kişi varsa {n, sprint, training, leave, research, pm, out}),
#             capacity: [{stage, work (dolgu), team (oluk), done (koşarken bu haftanın şimdiye dek yaptığı), out (sprint dışına kalan),
#             out_inside (onun önceki aşamayı beklerken kalan kısmı), streak (art arda taşan sprint, taşmıyorsa 0), hot (en çok taşan
#             aşama ve streak >= 2), shared (ekip yalnız kurucu), stays: [{card, effort}], people: [{person, busy, cut, effort}],
#             away: [{person, reason: training|leave|research|meetings}], cluster: null | {founders: [person], stars: [{stars, n,
#             person}], away: [{reason, n, person}]}}] or null (sprint yok ve sürüm notunda; efor sayıları kesirli, iş ve ekip
#             koşan sprintte kalan haftaların),
#             suggest: {amount, cards: [{name, done, effort}]} | null (öneri bu sprinte de sütuna da kart eklemiyorsa; yalnız
#             sütuna ekliyorsa {amount: 0.0, cards: []}: sayı çizilmez, yalnız düğme), candidates (boş planın ilk üç önerisi: kart satırı),

#   next: + {load: [{stage, carried, planned, team}], carried: [{card, card_id, stage, effort}]} (devreden: planlamada ve koşarken
#         zaman ekseninin `out`u, sürüm notunda sonraki sütunun devreden kartlarının kalan ihtiyacı; ikisini de aynı işlevler

#         sonundaki kalan ihtiyaç), done (bu sprintte önden yapılan), people: [person] (önden çalışanlar)}], ahead (önden işi bu

# Kart satırı (pano) = {id, kind, name, effort, raw_effort, module (kısa ad), module_name, fix_text (düzeltme kartında hata sayısı ve

#   yetişir), founder, gate (başlamayacak kartın kapı gerekçesi, yoksa ""), buttons, stages (SprintTimeline aşamaları)}. Planlamada

#   (`risk` ve `risk_raw` göstergedir).

const INBOX := preload("res://scripts/ui/components/inbox.gd")
## Kademenin adı.
const TIER_KEYS := {InfraSystem.PROVIDER_LOCAL: "PRODUCT_SERVER_TIER_ECONOMY", InfraSystem.PROVIDER_CLOUD: "PRODUCT_SERVER_TIER_STANDARD",
	InfraSystem.PROVIDER_ENTERPRISE: "PRODUCT_SERVER_TIER_ENTERPRISE"}
## Bir aşamanın satırı bu kadar kişiden çoksa yüzlerin yerini yıldız kümeleri alır.
const CLUSTER_OVER := 9
## Planlamada bu sprintin kartının ("→", "×") ve sonraki sprintin kartının ("↑", "×") düğmeleri.
const PLAN_KEYS := ["send_next", "remove"]
const NEXT_KEYS := ["pull", "remove"]


## Kaynak verilmediğinde sekmenin okuduğu model: ürün durumundan (GameState.product) ve sprint
## sistemlerinden kurulur. Tür seçilmeden alan ve kart yoktur; sekme o zaman tür seçiciyi açar.
static func live() -> Dictionary:
	_addable.clear()
	_ghosts.clear()
	var p: Dictionary = GameState.product
	var mode: String = SprintSystem.mode()
	var release: Dictionary = p.get("release", {}) if mode == "release" else {}
	# Bu ya da sonraki sprintte duran kartın sprint numarası: adaydaki kopyası soluklaşıp damga alır.
	var tags: Dictionary = {}
	for key in ["sprint", "next"]:
		var s: Dictionary = p.get(key, {})
		for id in s.get("cards", []):
			tags[id] = int(s.number)
	var versions: Array = []
	for r in p.get("releases", []):
		if int(r.number) > 0:
			# Sprintlerden önceki sürümün (eski kayıt) sprinti -1'dir; kart sayısı da bilinmez.
			versions.append({"label": SprintSystem.version_label(int(r.number)), "sprint": int(r.sprint),
				"shipped_count": -1 if int(r.sprint) < 0 else r.shipped.size(), "result": _result(r)})
	var live_now: bool = ProductState.is_live()
	var b2c_live: bool = live_now and ProductState.market_type() == "b2c"
	var n: int = SprintSystem.sprint_number()
	# Plan ekranı motorun oynatmasını söyler: kim kaç hafta, devreden, başlamayan, SPRINT SONUNDA ve sonraki
	# sütunun hazır payı. Zaman ekseni (koşan sprintte de) aynı oynatmadır: plan bir kez oynanır.
	var run: Dictionary = SprintSystem.timeline() if n > 0 and mode != "release" else {}
	var outcome: Dictionary = run.outcome if mode == "plan" and not run.is_empty() else {}
	# Liderin önerisi yalnız planlamada, devir kapalıyken ve uygulanmamışken (plan değişince bayrak düşer) okunur.
	var suggestion: Dictionary = SprintCatalog.NO_LEAD
	if mode == "plan" and n > 0 and not SprintSystem.delegated() and not p.sprint.get("lead_applied", false):
		suggestion = SprintCatalog.lead_suggestion()
	var planned: Array = p.get("sprint", {}).get("cards", []).map(func(id: String) -> String: return p.cards[id].area)
	var areas: Array = []
	var modules: Array = []
	var pool: Dictionary = {}
	for a in SprintCatalog.areas_for(ProductState.subtype(), ProductState.market_type()):
		var cards: Array = SprintCatalog.candidates(a.id)
		for c in cards:
			pool[c.id] = c
		areas.append({"id": a.id, "name": SprintCatalog.area_name(a.id), "goal_text": goal_text(a.id)})
		var module: Variant = _module(a.id, cards, a.id in planned, n, tags)
		if module != null:
			modules.append(module)
	var center: Dictionary = _center(mode, release, outcome)
	center.merge(_plan_view(mode, run, suggestion, pool), true)
	var next: Dictionary = _next(mode, run)
	return {
		"header": {
			# Adsız ürün tür adıyla okunur.
			"name": SalesSystem.product_display_name(),
			"live_version": SprintSystem.version_text(ProductState.version()) if live_now else "",
			"market": ProductState.market_type().to_upper(),
			"type_text": ProductCatalog.type_name(ProductState.subtype()),
			"users": int(SalesSystem.b2c_audience()) if b2c_live else -1,
			"paying": SalesSystem.b2c_paying_users() if b2c_live else -1,
		},
		"versions": versions,
		"quarter": _quarter(center, next),
		"ui": {"view": "sprint", "open_area": "", "history_open": false, "hover_card": "", "server_preview": "",
			"requests_open": false},
		"overview": {"server": _server()} if live_now else null,
		"areas": areas,
		"founder": _founder(mode, center.rnd_node),
		"requests": _requests(tags),
		"modules": modules,
		"prep": _prep(),
		"center": center,
		"next": next,
	}


# --- Modüller ve talepler ------------------------------------------------------------

## "+"nın değeri ve hayalet hesabı (`SprintSystem.timeline([aday])`) sayfanın bir sonraki kurulumuna kadar kart kimliğiyle burada
## durur: `live()` atar, `addable` ve `ghost` ister.

## Kartın etki satırı (ProductModel `part`): alan dilim geçişi, değişmiyorsa "Alan X kalır" ve
## yeteneğin geçişi; rakip açığı, talep ve verilmiş söz; düzeltmede hata sayısı, etkilenenler ve "!" kalkışı.
static func card_effect(card: Dictionary) -> Array:
	var area: String = card.area
	match card.kind:
		"fix":
			var parts: Array = [bugs_part(card.line, card.bugs)]
			if _clears_alert(card):
				parts.append({"k": "alert_clear", "area": area_short(area)})
			return parts
		"research":
			return [{"k": "research", "area": area_short(area)}]
	var level: Dictionary = _level_part(area, {card.line: card.target_tier})
	var out: Array = []
	if level.to != level.from:
		out.append(level)
	else:
		var cap_max: float = max_tier(card.line)
		var expect: float = ProductQuality.expectation(area)
		var cap_from: float = minf(tier(card.line) + polish(card.line), cap_max)
		var cap_to: float = minf(card.target_tier + polish(card.line), cap_max)
		out.append({"k": "holds", "area": area_short(area), "word": level.to_word})
		out.append({"k": "cap", "name": cap_name(card.line), "from": cap_from, "to": cap_to,
			"from_word": ProductQuality.word_for(cap_from, expect), "to_word": ProductQuality.word_for(cap_to, expect)})
	var request: Dictionary = _request_of(card)
	if not request.is_empty():
		out.append({"k": "request", "customer": customer_name(request), "value": int(request.value)})
	out.append_array(_promise_parts(card.step))

## `star` oku → B2C sayfa referansı iddiası FAIL; `ProductLines.register_runtime_line`dan `memo.clear()`i sil → gizli hat iddiası FAIL;
## `capabilities` önbelleğini `SprintCatalog`ta bir statik değişkene taşı ve yalnız `register_runtime_line` boşaltsın → yeniden yükleme iddiası FAIL.
static func _case_fit_star_context() -> String:
	_seed_sprint_live("erp")
	var asked := func(star: int, sector: String) -> Prospect:
		var p := Prospect.new()
		p.id = "lead_ctx_%d_%s" % [star, sector]
		p.company_name = p.id
		p.industry = sector
		p.star = star
		return p
	var said := func(key: String, args: Dictionary) -> String:
		return TranslationServer.translate(key).format(args)

	# MVP'den hemen sonra: Çekirdek 0,6. Sayfa 2★ şirketin referansını okur, cümle MVP'nin 1★'a yettiğini söyler.
	if ProductQuality.expectation("core", {"star": 1}) != 0.6 or ProductQuality.expectation("core") != 1.25 \
			or ProductQuality.expectation("trust") != 1.0 or ProductQuality.expectation("integrations") != 1.0 \
			or ProductQuality.expectation("revenue") != 0.0:
		return "the page reference reads core %.2f at 1 star and %.2f on the page, trust %.2f, integrations %.2f; want 0.6, 1.25, 1 and 1" % [
			ProductQuality.expectation("core", {"star": 1}), ProductQuality.expectation("core"),
			ProductQuality.expectation("trust"), ProductQuality.expectation("integrations")]
	if ProductQuality.word("core") != "weak" or ProductQuality.serves("core") != 1 \
			or SprintCatalog.area_sentence("core") != said.call("PRODUCT_STAR_SERVES", {"star": 1, "next": 2}):
		return "right after the MVP Core reads '%s', serves %d, says '%s'; want Weak, 1 and the 1 star sentence" % [
			ProductQuality.word("core"), ProductQuality.serves("core"), SprintCatalog.area_sentence("core")]
	if ProductQuality.next_star() != 2:
		return "right after the MVP the next star reads %d, want 2" % ProductQuality.next_star()
	if SprintCatalog.area_sentence("integrations") != said.call("PRODUCT_STAR_SKIPPED", {}) \
			or ProductQuality.word("integrations") != "none":
		return "an empty Integrations reads '%s' and says '%s'; want None and the line that 1 star companies do not look at it" % [
			ProductQuality.word("integrations"), SprintCatalog.area_sentence("integrations")]
	# Sayfanın referansı on üç sektörün en yükseğidir: her yıldızda her alan için.
	for star in [1, 2, 3]:
		for area in SprintCatalog.area_ids():
			var highest: float = 0.0
			for sector in ProductQuality.TABLE:
		return null
	_sim_day()
	return account


## B2B talebi: hesap imzadan bir sprint sonra sektörünün vurgu 1 alanından bir kademe ister.
## Talep kartı adaylarda ve liderin önerisinde görünür; son tarihten önce çıkan sürüm talebi karşılar ve aynı kademeye
## verilmiş sözü o sürümün "shipped"iyle tutar.
static func _case_sprint_request_on_time_met() -> String:
	var account: Customer = _seed_open_request()
	if account == null:
		return "fixture: sprint 1 did not start"
	var open: Array = GameState.product.requests.filter(func(r: Dictionary) -> bool: return r.status == "open")
	if open.size() != 1 or open[0].customer_id != account.id:
		return "a sprint after signing the account holds requests %s, want one from %s" % [open, account.id]
	var req: Dictionary = open[0]
	var deadline: int = SprintSystem.sprints_in(int(SprintCatalog.cfg("request.deadline_weeks")))
	if SprintCatalog.area_of_line(req.line) != ProductQuality.emphasis(account.industry)[0] \
			or int(req.due_sprint) != int(req.created_sprint) + deadline \
			or int(req.value) != account.mrr * 12:
		return "the request reads %s; want the sector's first emphasis area, the deadline sprint and a year of MRR" % req

	host.set("_call", {"kind": "sales", "id": "lead_clock"})
	host.call("_on_call_postponed")
	check.call("Ertele")
	EventBus.speed_change_requested.emit(0)   # the trip
	host.set("_meeting_panel", MeetingPanel.new())
	host.call("_close_meeting", SittingStub.new())
	check.call("the sitting")
	EventBus.speed_change_requested.emit(0)   # the trip to the table
	host.call("_close_term_table")
	check.call("the term table")
	var product: Node = (load("res://scripts/tabs/product_tab.gd") as GDScript).new()
	product.call("_hold_clock", true)
	product.call("_hold_clock", false)
	check.call("the release note")
	product.call("_hold_clock", true)
	product.call("on_page_closing")
	check.call("the closing product page")
	product.free()
	# A held clock opens no sitting: the sales pitch, the term-sheet table and the seed pitch refuse it.
	# FALSIFICATION: drop _meeting_refused from main._on_pitch_requested → the sales sitting opens.
	GameState.set_flag("mvp_shipped", true)
	GameState.set_flag("mvp_market_type", "b2b")
	_seed_b2b_lines("erp", 2)
	GameState.set_current_hour(10)
	TimeManager.sync_to_current_hour()
	GameState.set_phase(3)
